## Batch 18 authored

Completed the six draft items, both frontmatter-only pages, manifest, source coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch dependency record, and authoring notes. The order-two example now proves both a strict region inside \(\mathcal K_2\) and a strict region excluded from it.

**All six Step 1 records are `escalated`.** The A page’s logical requirement `qftx-eft-operator-quotients` has seven current item carriers, but their Step 1 readiness records are missing. Its inspected interface also does not supply a matching map from the generic quotient \(Q_D\) to the forward coefficients \(b_k\). The authored claims therefore remain at the on-shell amplitude level. The second A-page edge, `qftx-on-shell-amplitudes`, was verified as contextual.

## Checks

Proof layout passed with 0 defects; normative precheck passed all four proof-bearing items; rendercheck passed for all eight files. Strict proof contracts passed 6/6, boundary audit found no contradicted dispositions, focused dependency and content-policy checks passed, and all three selected full-text sources were fetch-verified. The coverage record contains 13 harvested source dispositions. [Adams et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/0602178), [de Rham et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1702.06134), and the complete [Basile et al. lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.08690.pdf) are recorded there.

Scoped item levels are **0, 1, 2, 1, 3, 4**, with no errors. Two owner-controlled checks remain unresolved: focused `fwdcheck` flags the A and B pages both at order 974 while B requires A; the shared batch-level record is stale because of changes in batches 9, 20, 21, and 24. The run-wide page-layout check also stops at the unrelated empty inventory `aqft-eft-operators`, so the engine has not set `page_layout: compact-v1` on these pages.
